manual.clinker_brick.line3: The art of brickmaking has progressed past wasting parts of the batch by producing clinker from overheating.{0}
manual.clinker_brick.line4: Those looking to recreate the iconic look of clinker brick facades may heat bricks in the §2Smoker§r to vitrify and char the facades into §2Clinker Bricks§r.{0}
manual.clinker_brick.line6: To complement the look of facades made from them, clinker bricks can be combined with terracotta to produce several decorative variants for facades: §2Clinker Brick Quoins§r and §2Sills§r.
manual.clinker_brick.line8: Clinker Bricks can also be formed into stairs, slabs, and walls.{0}
manual.clinker_brick.line9: §2Clinker Brick Walls§r have a small sill of baked brick on the top-most layer.
